description: Test suite for WhatsApp target normalization and detection functions, verifying correctness of functions like normalizeWhatsAppTarget, isWhatsAppUserTarget, isWhatsAppGroupJid, and looksLikeWhatsAppTargetId.

methods.name: normalizeWhatsAppTarget
methods.description: Normalizes various WhatsApp target identifiers to their canonical form, such as converting different user or group JID formats to standard E.164 or group ID formats.

methods.name: isWhatsAppUserTarget
methods.description: Determines if a given identifier corresponds to a WhatsApp user target based on format.

methods.name: isWhatsAppGroupJid
methods.description: Determines if a given identifier is a WhatsApp group JID.

methods.name: normalizeWhatsAppMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes messaging targets, returning undefined for blank inputs.

methods.name: looksLikeWhatsAppTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a valid WhatsApp target identifier.
